sources.note: Nothing on Saruga; classification, population (C15 Saruga 132) and short comparative lists. Its only prosodic remarks ('appears to be tonal', pp. 585-6) concern Biyom and Isabi, not Saruga.

sources.note: Survey-wide only, sec. 1.3.3 p. 7: 'The marking of stress has been omitted, since the stress patterning has not been well established yet.'
